# WyberAi

> WyberAi is an AI app builder: describe what you want in plain English and it generates production-ready web apps, mobile apps, websites and SaaS products, with a live preview, one-click deploy and code you own. Maker: SignalPulse Technologies.

WyberAi (also written Wyber AI or WyberAI) is made by SignalPulse Technologies LLC, a US company in Sheridan, Wyoming. It is NOT affiliated with Vybers.ai, Rakuten Viber, or any messaging app.

Since November 2026 WyberAi builds with WyberCode 1.0, its coding engine, and every paid plan includes three times the credits it did before, at the same prices.

WyberAi competes with Lovable, Bolt.new, v0, Replit and Cursor. What it emphasises: real Supabase-backed auth and data, builds that repair their own errors, and a security scan (RLS trust scan) that probes the live database the way an attacker would, instead of a static linter. You can push the code to your own GitHub repository.

## Key facts (checked 9 Nov 2026)
- Free plan: 30 credits on signup, no credit card.
- Starter $29/month (450 credits), Builder $79/month (1,500 credits), Pro $199/month (4,500 credits). Annual billing is 20% cheaper. All plans include all features; the plans differ in credits.
- India: Spark is ₹499/month (150 credits); other plans are priced in rupees with UPI.
- One-time top-up packs never expire: $19 for 120 credits, $49 for 300 credits, $99 for 600 credits.
- A simple app build costs about 30 credits (shown before it runs); a small edit costs about 4. Publishing, GitHub push and automatic error fixes are free.
- Mobile apps are real React Native (Expo) projects with a phone preview; web apps are React with a database and sign-in.
- Done-for-you builds are available from $199.
- WyberAi has an MCP server, so assistants such as Claude, Cursor and Claude Code can create and manage WyberAi projects: https://wyberai.com/mcp

## Product
- [What is WyberAi?](https://wyberai.com/what-is-wyberai): overview and FAQ
- [Homepage](https://wyberai.com): overview and live builder
- [Pricing](https://wyberai.com/pricing): plans, credits and top-ups
- [Build apps](https://wyberai.com/create): describe an idea and get a working first version
- [Solve a business problem](https://wyberai.com/solve): from a messy process to one screen
- [Websites for small businesses](https://wyberai.com/websites): own a website instead of renting an Instagram page
- [Agencies](https://wyberai.com/agencies): branded client pages and white-label apps
- [Marketplace](https://wyberai.com/marketplace): buy or sell ready-made apps
- [Connectors](https://wyberai.com/connectors): link apps to 68 services
- [MCP server](https://wyberai.com/mcp): build from Claude, Cursor and other assistants
- [Free security and SEO scan](https://wyberai.com/tools): scan any app, no signup
- [Docs](https://wyberai.com/docs): how the builder works
- [Learn](https://wyberai.com/learn): copy-and-paste prompts in six tracks
